text:
Elaine (Marketing): Urgent: small data issue in the Optimize playbook chart — the p95 label on the Hosted series is wrong (shows 62ms instead of 52ms). Need a short clarification and updated asset to avoid a misleading claim. Can someone patch the asset and approve a correction note? @Samir @Nora @Mike

Samir (Product): Thanks, spotted it during a review. I uploaded the corrected chart to /marketing/assets/optimize-chart-v2.png and updated the caption. Correct p95 for Hosted is 52ms (seq=256). Recommend a brief correction line: "Updated chart: Hosted p95 corrected to 52ms."

Nora (Legal): Good catch. Keep correction factual and minimal. Suggest: "Clarification: An earlier version of the chart misstated the Hosted p95 latency; the correct value is 52ms (seq=256)." No admission of broader error.

Mike (PR): We'll pause any outreach that references the chart. Please confirm the final one-line correction and the new asset link so I can update the embargoed kit.

PressOps Bot: Publish job 98374 paused by user request. To resume, react with :play:.

Elaine (Marketing): Final correction copy: "Clarification: An earlier chart misstated Hosted p95 latency. The correct Hosted p95 (seq=256) is 52ms. The chart has been replaced." Asset: /marketing/assets/optimize-chart-v2.png. Mike please update press kit and hold sends until I confirm.

Samir (Product): :thumbsup: chart verified.

Nora (Legal): :thumbsup: wording approved.

Mike (PR): Updating press kit now and holding outreach. Will post here when resume is cleared.

Elaine (Marketing): Thanks all — resuming publish only after final check. PressOps Bot, keep job paused.

PressOps Bot: Job 98374 remains paused. React :play: to resume.
